diagram_sets.title: [enc] Actor Authorization Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative source structure, typed security service contract, and relational approval and audit storage for attributable authorization across API, Siren, and MCP. Identity verification remains provider-neutral behind an ABC while the MCP SDK owns bearer resource-server enforcement. Approval is bound to an actor and canonical operation intent and is consumed once.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Architecture Contract Manifest Comparison
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative architecture-conformance design and sole structural source of truth for compilation, language-neutral assertions, canonical implementation evidence, explicit binding outcomes, semantic comparison, and coverage. Issue #235 supersedes implementation-shaped expected and observed records. SOLID and OCP boundaries use focused injectable services and ABC extension seams; source paths, raw annotations, framework descriptors, and provider taxonomies stop at evidence adapters. The Project Architecture Conformance Health set consumes these outcomes and must not redefine this structure.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Diagram MCP Presentations
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure and typed service contract for bounded diagram MCP projections, Sirenity 8.0 collection pagination and item follow-ups, and revision-pinned focused content reads without Enclosure navigation glue.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Enclosure Application Architecture
diagram_sets.description: Cross-application architecture overview. Projects Facade Contract (iTkQ6MwPHJvoHsvuqhG8M4) is the canonical complete ProjectsService contract. Project Operating Contract (YFbdEtuJaFUy6rrjxgDtF8) and Workspace Context Contract (mVYgBP3pdRCBk7PbwmgH6T) own their subsystem source and behavior; their facade nodes are scoped integration references. Architecture Configuration Storage owns only Project and ProjectArchitectureConfiguration persistence.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Guidance Health Contract
diagram_sets.description: Source-of-truth contracts for project-wide guidance graph persistence, validation, health aggregation, and reusable isolated architecture-health execution. Tree and UML describe the same implementation unit; ER owns the relational GuidanceRelationship model.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Language MCP Presentations
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure and typed service contract for issue #154: compact language catalogue and exact language MCP presentations using the existing public language operations and shared bounded presentation service.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] MCP Application Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative package structure and typed service contract for the first-class Enclosure MCP application. Sirenity 8.0 typed continuations, independent follow-ups, item follow-ups, and verifications pass through the generic gateway and presentation boundary without Enclosure navigation glue. Workspace-context semantics remain owned by Workspace Context Contract (mVYgBP3pdRCBk7PbwmgH6T); operation-specific project templates and reads remain owned by Project MCP Presentation Contract (QYp2QYaBeYf2HzbF3BtV3j).

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Portable Project Registration
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure, typed service contract, and relational storage for stable Project identity separated from explicit local WorkspaceBinding values. Project.id remains the single portable logical identity; roots are local bindings, multiple worktrees coexist, and rebinding is explicit and revision-checked.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Project Architecture Conformance Health
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative source of truth only for the health boundary: bounded execution, owner-aware finding projection, presentation, and attestation. This set consumes conformance, binding, comparison, and coverage outcomes owned by the Architecture Contract Manifest Comparison set; it does not redefine their structure or semantics. Issue #235 binds attestations to accepted intent, canonical implementation evidence, explicit realization outcomes, comparison policy, and terminal findings. Health never reinterprets source-language representations or prescribes source changes for contract, realization, or observer defects.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Project Architecture Contract Publication
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure, typed service boundary, and immutable relational storage for issue #228. Enclosure binds accepted contract units to exact Tree, UML, and entity snapshots plus Mermaiden contract identity. The archived snapshot is derived, immutable evidence and never a second editable diagram authority. Operating-contract architecture references select accepted publications. Manifest compilation and comparison remain owned by #230; health attestations remain owned by #229.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Project MCP Presentation Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure and typed service contract for compact project MCP projections, Sirenity 8.0 collection pagination and item follow-ups, deterministic insight paging, bounded architecture and health content, and direct typed recovery without Enclosure navigation glue.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Project Operating Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative source tree, typed subsystem contract, and normalized relational storage for immutable project operating-contract revisions and explicit project bindings. ProjectsService is a scoped integration reference; its complete facade contract is Projects Facade Contract (iTkQ6MwPHJvoHsvuqhG8M4).

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Record MCP Presentations
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure and typed service contract for context-efficient Record MCP presentations, Sirenity 8.0 collection item reads, and revision-pinned typed recovery without Enclosure navigation glue.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Scaffolding MCP Presentations
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative structure and typed service contract for bounded scaffolding catalogue, detail, template content, rendering manifests, focused generated-file reads, and Sirenity 8.0 collection item navigation without Enclosure navigation glue.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Strict Schema Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative package structure and shared schema foundation for issue #238. StrictSchema is the one public immutable Pydantic base for in-scope input and output contracts: unknown fields are forbidden, instances are frozen, and attribute projection is supported. Records, Projects, Diagrams, and Scaffoldings own their concrete schemas and validations through #239-#242; Plans is out of scope. Output contracts only project already-valid state and never establish, repair, reinterpret, or reconfirm correctness.

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Workspace Context Contract
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative source tree and typed service contract for request-time workspace context and its compact deterministic ContextReceipt. Routing decisions are consumed from Workspace Context Routing (jQdv3fGoeg5xnzQc6u9rs9); operating-contract authority comes from Project Operating Contract (YFbdEtuJaFUy6rrjxgDtF8); Markdown and structured projections remain owned by MCP Application Contract (zdf5eGMfV72FduMG9KU6N2).

diagram_sets.title: [enc] Workspace Context Routing
diagram_sets.description: Authoritative package, typed service, relational guidance-scope, and receipt-safe route-fact contract for deterministic task-focused workspace-context routing. Mandatory guidance remains owned by the active Project Operating Contract; optional records remain owned by Records and are only made eligible here through GuidanceScope. GuidanceRoute exposes stable selection reasons, budget use, omissions, and missing mandatory ids without similarity scores or evaluated-candidate dumps.
